pages.title: Cognitive Singularity
pages.text: Every thought that could be thought, from a single neural lattice up to a superintelligence and a Boltzmann brain, compressed into one point. It feels attentive. Holding it, I am briefly aware of ideas I have not had yet, and then they are gone.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed every model of mind I had built into the Compressor, from neural lattices to general AI cores and holographic matrices. Thought itself collapsed to a single, watchful point.

Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Identity Kernel, Omega Simulator, Omniscience Catalyst, Ontological Junction, Proof of Everything, Spacetime Bearing.
